entities.summary: The Old Cathedral of St. Mary of the Immaculate Conception is a proto-cathedral and Catholic parish on California Street at Grant Avenue in the Chinatown neighborhood of San Francisco, California. It was built in 1854 in the Gothic Revival style, and was made a Designated San Francisco Landmark on April 11, 1968.
